'''UGBS''' was a business that operated two different shops in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Color/Legends|blue]] neon sign with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters, identifying the name of the business, was put up above each shop in order to attract customers, although the signage was mirror-inverted.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Behind the scenes==
This business makes its first, and only, appearance in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode ''[[Evil Plans]]''.<ref name="Evil Plans" />
